question_en: Which statements are true? 1) inside a uniform spherical shell the field is zero; 2) a geostationary satellite can hover over any latitude; 3) the orbital energy depends only on the semi-major axis; 4) the Sun is at the center of the ellipse; 5) for $F\propto r^{-4}$ circular orbits are unstable.
question_uz: Qaysi fikrlar to'g'ri? 1) bir jinsli sferik qobiq ichida maydon nol; 2) geostatsionar yo'ldosh istalgan kenglik ustida tura oladi; 3) orbita energiyasi faqat katta yarim o'qqa bog'liq; 4) Quyosh ellips markazida; 5) $F\propto r^{-4}$ da aylana orbitalar barqaror emas.
question_ru: Какие утверждения верны? 1) внутри однородной сферической оболочки поле равно нулю; 2) геостационарный спутник может висеть над любой широтой; 3) энергия орбиты зависит только от большой полуоси; 4) Солнце в центре эллипса; 5) при $F\propto r^{-4}$ круговые орбиты неустойчивы.
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: B. Geostatsionar orbita faqat ekvator tekisligida (2 xato); Quyosh fokusda (4 xato).
Asos: orbitalar xossalari.

uz: 2) orbita tekisligi Yer markazidan o'tadi — faqat ekvator ustida; 4) Quyosh fokusda: $$r=\frac{p}{1+e\cos\theta}$$
ru: 2) плоскость орбиты проходит через центр Земли — только над экватором; 4) Солнце в фокусе: $$r=\frac{p}{1+e\cos\theta}$$
en: 2) the orbital plane passes through the Earth's center — only over the equator; 4) the Sun is at a focus: $$r=\frac{p}{1+e\cos\theta}$$

distractors.C: geostatsionar orbita istalgan kenglikda deb olingan; 3 tushib qolgan
distractors.D: Quyosh markazda deb olingan; 1 tushib qolgan

distractors_ru.C: принято, что геостационарная орбита возможна на любой широте; пропущено 3
distractors_ru.D: принято, что Солнце в центре; пропущено 1
distractors_ru.E: принято, что Солнце в центре эллипса

distractors_en.C: a geostationary orbit was allowed at any latitude; 3 missed
distractors_en.D: the Sun was put at the center; 1 missed
distractors_en.E: the Sun was put at the center of the ellipse

source: original (B2-L08, tushuncha testi)

question_en: The gravitational acceleration at a planet's surface is $g_0$. What is it at a height equal to the planet's radius?
question_uz: Sayyora sirtida og'irlik tezlanishi $g_0$. Sirtdan sayyora radiusiga teng balandlikda u qancha?
question_ru: Ускорение свободного падения на поверхности планеты $g_0$. Каково оно на высоте, равной радиусу планеты?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: C. Markazgacha masofa 2R, g ∝ 1/r²: g₀/4.
Asos: butun olam tortishish qonuni.

ru: Расстояние отсчитывается от центра, а не от поверхности: $r=2R$: $$g=g_0\frac{R^2}{(2R)^2}=\frac{g_0}{4}$$
en: The distance is measured from the center, not the surface: $r=2R$: $$g=g_0\frac{R^2}{(2R)^2}=\frac{g_0}{4}$$

source: OpenStax, «University Physics», Vol. 1 (CC BY 4.0), 13.62-masala asosida; sharti o'zgartirilgan

question_en: An asteroid's orbit has a semi-major axis of $2.25\ \mathrm{AU}$. What is its period in years?
question_uz: Asteroid orbitasining katta yarim o'qi $2.25\ \mathrm{AU}$. Uning aylanish davri necha yil?
question_ru: Большая полуось орбиты астероида $2.25\ \mathrm{AU}$. Каков его период обращения в годах?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: A. T² = a³: T = 2.25·√2.25 = 1.5³ = 3.375 yil.
Asos: Keplerning uchinchi qonuni.
source: OpenStax, «University Physics», Vol. 1 (CC BY 4.0), 13.53-masala asosida; sharti o'zgartirilgan

question_en: Two satellites orbit the same planet on circular orbits of radii $r$ and $4r$. What is the ratio of their periods $\frac{T_2}{T_1}$?
question_uz: Ikki yo'ldosh bir sayyora atrofida radiuslari $r$ va $4r$ bo'lgan aylana orbitalarda harakatlanadi. Ularning davrlari nisbati $\frac{T_2}{T_1}$ qancha?
question_ru: Два спутника движутся вокруг одной планеты по круговым орбитам радиусами $r$ и $4r$. Каково отношение их периодов $\frac{T_2}{T_1}$?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: D. T² ∝ r³: T₂/T₁ = 4·√4 = 8.
Asos: Keplerning uchinchi qonuni.
source: OpenStax, «University Physics», Vol. 1 (CC BY 4.0), 13.37-masala asosida; sharti o'zgartirilgan

question_en: A planet has both radius and mean density $2$ times those of the Earth. By what factor does its escape speed exceed the Earth's?
question_uz: Sayyora radiusi ham, o'rtacha zichligi ham Yernikidan $2$ marta katta. Undan qochish tezligi Yernikidan necha marta katta?
question_ru: И радиус, и средняя плотность планеты в $2$ раза больше, чем у Земли. Во сколько раз скорость убегания с неё больше земной?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: E. v₂ = √(2GM/R) ∝ R√ρ: 2·√2 = 2√2.
Asos: qochish tezligi.

distractors.D: massa nisbati (16) emas, v₂² ∝ R²ρ ning o'zi olingan

distractors_en.D: R²ρ itself was taken instead of its root

source: OpenStax, «University Physics», Vol. 1 (CC BY 4.0), 13.27-masala asosida; sharti o'zgartirilgan

question_en: What minimum energy is needed to move a satellite of mass $m$ from a circular orbit of radius $r$ to one of radius $3r$? The planet's mass is $M$.
question_uz: Massasi $m$ bo'lgan yo'ldoshni radiusi $r$ aylana orbitadan radiusi $3r$ aylana orbitaga o'tkazish uchun kamida qancha energiya kerak? Sayyora massasi $M$.
question_ru: Какая минимальная энергия нужна, чтобы перевести спутник массой $m$ с круговой орбиты радиусом $r$ на круговую орбиту радиусом $3r$? Масса планеты $M$.
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: B. ΔE = GMm/(2r) − GMm/(6r) = GMm/(3r).
Asos: orbita energiyasi.

distractors_en.A: only the magnitude of the initial energy was taken
distractors_en.C: the difference of potential energies was taken
distractors_en.D: only the magnitude of the final energy was taken
distractors_en.E: the magnitude of the initial potential energy was taken

source: OpenStax, «University Physics», Vol. 1 (CC BY 4.0), 13.71-masala asosida; sharti o'zgartirilgan

question_en: What is the ratio of a circular-orbit satellite's total energy to its kinetic energy, $\frac{E}{E_k}$?
question_uz: Aylana orbitadagi yo'ldosh to'liq energiyasining kinetik energiyasiga nisbati $\frac{E}{E_k}$ qancha?
question_ru: Каково отношение полной энергии спутника на круговой орбите к его кинетической энергии $\frac{E}{E_k}$?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: C. Aylanada Eₖ = −U/2, demak E = Eₖ + U = −Eₖ.
Asos: virial munosabati.

distractors_en.B: the sign and the ratio were confused
distractors_en.E: the energy was taken as positive

source: OpenStax, «University Physics», Vol. 1 (CC BY 4.0), 13.71-masala asosida; sharti o'zgartirilgan

question_en: A satellite on a circular orbit of radius $R$ has period $T_0$. Another satellite has perigee $R$ and apogee $3R$ (distances from the planet's center). What is its period?
question_uz: Radiusi $R$ aylana orbitadagi yo'ldosh davri $T_0$. Boshqa yo'ldoshning perigeyi $R$, apogeyi $3R$ (masofalar sayyora markazidan). Uning davri qancha?
question_ru: Период спутника на круговой орбите радиусом $R$ равен $T_0$. Перигей другого спутника $R$, апогей $3R$ (расстояния от центра планеты). Каков его период?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: A. Katta yarim o'q a = (R + 3R)/2 = 2R; T = 2·√2·T₀.
Asos: Keplerning uchinchi qonuni.

en: The third law uses the semi-major axis: $$a=\frac{R+3R}{2}=2R,\qquad T=T_0\left(\frac{2R}{R}\right)^{3/2}=2\sqrt{2}T_0$$

distractors_en.B: the apogee 3R was used instead of a

source: OpenStax, «University Physics», Vol. 1 (CC BY 4.0), 13.53-masala asosida; sharti o'zgartirilgan

question_en: At distance $r$ from the center a body's speed is $\sqrt{\frac{3GM}{2r}}$ (direction unknown). What is the semi-major axis of its orbit?
question_uz: Markazdan $r$ masofada jism tezligi $\sqrt{\frac{3GM}{2r}}$ (yo'nalishi noma'lum). Uning orbitasining katta yarim o'qi qancha?
question_ru: На расстоянии $r$ от центра скорость тела $\sqrt{\frac{3GM}{2r}}$ (направление неизвестно). Какова большая полуось его орбиты?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: D. Vis-viva: 3/(2r) = 2/r − 1/a, ya'ni 1/a = 1/(2r), a = 2r. Yo'nalish kerak emas.
Asos: vis-viva tenglamasi.

uz: Vis-viva tenglamasi faqat $r$ va $v$ ni talab qiladi: $$\frac{3}{2r}=\frac{2}{r}-\frac{1}{a}\ \Rightarrow\ a=2r$$
ru: Уравнение vis-viva требует лишь $r$ и $v$: $$\frac{3}{2r}=\frac{2}{r}-\frac{1}{a}\ \Rightarrow\ a=2r$$
en: The vis-viva equation needs only $r$ and $v$: $$\frac{3}{2r}=\frac{2}{r}-\frac{1}{a}\ \Rightarrow\ a=2r$$

distractors.C: katta yarim o'q emas, katta o'q 2a berilgan

distractors_ru.C: дана большая ось 2a, а не полуось

distractors_en.B: the coefficient of the squared speed was taken
distractors_en.C: the major axis 2a was given instead of the semi-major axis

source: original (B2-L08, vis-viva)

question_en: The components of a binary star are $10\ \mathrm{AU}$ apart and the orbital period is $20$ years. What is the sum of the stellar masses in solar masses?
question_uz: Qo'shaloq yulduz komponentlari orasidagi masofa $10\ \mathrm{AU}$, aylanish davri $20$ yil. Yulduzlar massalari yig'indisi necha Quyosh massasiga teng?
question_ru: Расстояние между компонентами двойной звезды $10\ \mathrm{AU}$, период обращения $20$ лет. Сколько масс Солнца составляет сумма масс звёзд?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: E. Quyosh birliklarida m₁ + m₂ = a³/T² = 1000/400 = 2.5.
Asos: Keplerning uchinchi qonuni (ikki jism).

distractors.C: ikki yulduzning har biri uchun yarim massa hisoblangan

source: OpenStax, «University Physics», Vol. 1 (CC BY 4.0), 13.78-masala asosida; sharti o'zgartirilgan

question_en: The gravitational acceleration at the surface of a uniform planet is $g_0$. What is it at a distance $\frac{R}{3}$ from the center (in a shaft inside the planet)?
question_uz: Bir jinsli sayyora sirtida og'irlik tezlanishi $g_0$. Markazdan $\frac{R}{3}$ masofada (sayyora ichidagi shaxtada) u qancha?
question_ru: Ускорение свободного падения на поверхности однородной планеты $g_0$. Каково оно на расстоянии $\frac{R}{3}$ от центра (в шахте внутри планеты)?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: B. Ichkarida faqat M(r/R)³ massa tortadi: g = g₀r/R = g₀/3.
Asos: shar ichidagi maydon.

uz: Qobiq teoremasi: tashqi qatlamlar maydon bermaydi: $$g=\frac{GM}{r^2}\cdot\frac{r^3}{R^3}=g_0\frac{r}{R}=\frac{g_0}{3}$$
ru: Теорема о слое: внешние слои поля не создают: $$g=\frac{GM}{r^2}\cdot\frac{r^3}{R^3}=g_0\frac{r}{R}=\frac{g_0}{3}$$
en: Shell theorem: the outer layers give no field: $$g=\frac{GM}{r^2}\cdot\frac{r^3}{R^3}=g_0\frac{r}{R}=\frac{g_0}{3}$$

distractors.D: ichkarida ham g ∝ 1/r² deb olingan (r = R/3)

distractors_en.A: the outside 1/r² law was applied in reverse
distractors_en.D: g ∝ 1/r² was used inside too (r = R/3)
distractors_en.E: the field was taken as constant

source: OpenStax, «University Physics», Vol. 1 (CC BY 4.0), 13.81-masala asosida; sharti o'zgartirilgan

question_en: If the attractive force were proportional to $\frac{1}{r}$, by what factor would the period change if the radius of a circular orbit increased by a factor of $2$?
question_uz: Agar tortishish kuchi $\frac{1}{r}$ ga proporsional bo'lganida, aylana orbita radiusi $2$ marta ortsa, aylanish davri necha marta o'zgarardi?
question_ru: Если бы сила притяжения была пропорциональна $\frac{1}{r}$, во сколько раз изменился бы период обращения при увеличении радиуса круговой орбиты в $2$ раза?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: C. mv²/r ∝ 1/r — tezlik o'zgarmas, T = 2πr/v ∝ r: 2 marta.
Asos: daraja ko'rinishidagi kuch.

distractors_en.E: the period was taken as unchanged (oscillator)

source: Kahn & Anderson, «Conquering the Physics GRE», 1.6 g'oyasi asosida; sharti o'zgartirilgan

question_en: The figure shows the gravitational field of a spherical planet as a function of distance from its center. What is the escape speed from the planet's surface?
question_uz: Rasmda sferik sayyora gravitatsiya maydoni kuchlanganligining markazgacha masofaga bog'liqligi berilgan. Sayyora sirtidan qochish tezligi qancha?
question_ru: На рисунке показана зависимость напряжённости поля тяготения сферической планеты от расстояния до центра. Какова скорость убегания с поверхности планеты?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: A. Grafikdagi cho'qqi — sirt: R = 2000 km, g = 4 m/s²; v₂ = √(2gR) = 4 km/s.
Asos: qochish tezligi.

en: The field is largest at the surface: $R=2\cdot10^6\ \mathrm{m}$, $g=4\ \mathrm{m/s^2}$; $GM=gR^2$: $$v_2=\sqrt{2gR}=\sqrt{2\cdot4\cdot2\cdot10^6}=4\ \mathrm{km/s}$$

source: original (B2-L08, g(r) grafigi)

question_en: A satellite is launched perpendicular to the radius at $1.1$ times the circular-orbit speed at that point. What is the eccentricity of the orbit?
question_uz: Yo'ldosh shu nuqtadagi aylana orbita tezligidan $1.1$ marta katta tezlik bilan radiusga perpendikulyar otildi. Orbita ekssentrisiteti qancha?
question_ru: Спутник запущен перпендикулярно радиусу со скоростью в $1.1$ раза больше круговой скорости в этой точке. Каков эксцентриситет орбиты?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: D. Otish nuqtasi perigey: v² = GM(1 + e)/rₚ, demak 1 + e = 1.21, e = 0.21.
Asos: perisentrdagi tezlik.
source: original (B2-L08, ekssentrisitet)

question_en: The Moon's mass is $81$ times smaller than the Earth's, and they are $60R$ apart ($R$ is the Earth's radius). How far from the Earth's center is the center of mass of the Earth–Moon system?
question_uz: Oy massasi Yernikidan $81$ marta kichik, ular orasidagi masofa $60R$ ($R$ — Yer radiusi). Yer–Oy sistemasining massa markazi Yer markazidan qanday masofada?
question_ru: Масса Луны в $81$ раз меньше массы Земли, расстояние между ними $60R$ ($R$ — радиус Земли). На каком расстоянии от центра Земли находится центр масс системы Земля–Луна?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: E. r₁ = d·m/(M + m) = 60R/82 ≈ 0.73R — Yer ichida.
Asos: massa markazi.

en: The radii are inversely proportional to the masses: $$r_1=d\frac{m}{M+m}=\frac{60R}{82}\approx0.73R$$

distractors_en.A: the square root of the mass ratio was used
distractors_en.B: the masses were taken as equal
distractors_en.C: the distance from the Moon was computed

source: OpenStax, «University Physics», Vol. 1 (CC BY 4.0), 13.44-masala asosida; sharti o'zgartirilgan

question_en: A particle moves in a bounded way in the potential $U=cx^4$ ($c>0$). What is the ratio of its average kinetic energy to its total energy, $\frac{\langle E_k\rangle}{E}$?
question_uz: Zarra $U=cx^4$ potensialda ($c>0$) chegaralangan harakat qiladi. Uning o'rtacha kinetik energiyasining to'liq energiyaga nisbati $\frac{\langle E_k\rangle}{E}$ qancha?
question_ru: Частица совершает финитное движение в потенциале $U=cx^4$ ($c>0$). Каково отношение её средней кинетической энергии к полной энергии $\frac{\langle E_k\rangle}{E}$?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: B. Virial: 2⟨Eₖ⟩ = 4⟨U⟩, ⟨U⟩ = ⟨Eₖ⟩/2; E = 1.5⟨Eₖ⟩, nisbat 2/3.
Asos: virial teorema.

distractors_en.E: ⟨Eₖ⟩ = ν⟨U⟩ was used instead of 2⟨Eₖ⟩ = ν⟨U⟩

source: original (B2-L08, virial teorema)

question_en: A central attractive force goes as $F\propto r^{-n}$. For which of the values $n=-1,\ 1,\ 2,\ 3,\ 4$ are circular orbits stable?
question_uz: Markaziy tortishish kuchi $F\propto r^{-n}$. $n=-1,\ 1,\ 2,\ 3,\ 4$ qiymatlarining qaysilarida aylana orbitalar barqaror?
question_ru: Центральная сила притяжения $F\propto r^{-n}$. При каких из значений $n=-1,\ 1,\ 2,\ 3,\ 4$ круговые орбиты устойчивы?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: C. Barqarorlik sharti n < 3; n = 3 — chegaraviy (farqsiz), barqaror emas.
Asos: effektiv potensial minimumi.

uz: $\tilde U''>0$ sharti — radial tebranish chastotasi haqiqiy: $$\omega_r^2=(3-n)\omega^2>0\ \Rightarrow\ n<3$$
ru: Условие $\tilde U''>0$ — частота радиальных колебаний вещественна: $$\omega_r^2=(3-n)\omega^2>0\ \Rightarrow\ n<3$$
en: The condition $\tilde U''>0$ — the radial oscillation frequency is real: $$\omega_r^2=(3-n)\omega^2>0\ \Rightarrow\ n<3$$

distractors_ru.A: взяты лишь силы с замкнутыми орбитами (Бертран)

distractors_en.A: only the closed-orbit forces (Bertrand) were taken
distractors_en.D: n = −1 was dropped and n = 3 added
distractors_en.E: n = 3 was also taken as stable

source: Kahn & Anderson, «Conquering the Physics GRE», 1.6 g'oyasi asosida; sharti o'zgartirilgan

question_en: A central attractive force goes as $F\propto\frac{1}{r}$. Through what angle does the position vector turn from pericenter to the next apocenter on a nearly circular orbit (the apsidal angle)?
question_uz: Markaziy tortishish kuchi $F\propto\frac{1}{r}$. Aylanaga yaqin orbitada perisentrdan keyingi aposentrgacha radius-vektor qanday burchakka buriladi (apsidal burchak)?
question_ru: Центральная сила притяжения $F\propto\frac{1}{r}$. На какой угол поворачивается радиус-вектор от перицентра до следующего апоцентра на орбите, близкой к круговой (апсидальный угол)?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: A. radial chastota ω√(3 − n) = √2·ω; yarim radial tebranishda burilish π/√2 ≈ 127°.
Asos: radial tebranishlar.

en: Rotation during half a radial period $\frac{\pi\omega}{\omega_r}$: $$\omega_r=\omega\sqrt{3-1}\ \Rightarrow\ \Delta\theta=\frac{\pi}{\sqrt{2}}$$

distractors.D: radial chastota ω√(4 − n) deb olingan

distractors_ru.D: радиальная частота взята как ω√(4 − n)

distractors_en.D: the radial frequency was taken as ω√(4 − n)

source: original (B2-L08, apsidal burchak)

question_en: A body flies past a star ($GM=1.33\cdot10^{20}\ \mathrm{m^3/s^2}$) with speed at infinity $100\ \mathrm{km/s}$ and impact parameter $1.33\cdot10^{12}\ \mathrm{m}$. What is the deflection angle in radians, approximately?
question_uz: Yulduz ($GM=1.33\cdot10^{20}\ \mathrm{m^3/s^2}$) yonidan cheksizlikdagi tezligi $100\ \mathrm{km/s}$, nishon masofasi $1.33\cdot10^{12}\ \mathrm{m}$ bo'lgan jism uchib o'tadi. Og'ish burchagi taxminan necha radian?
question_ru: Мимо звезды ($GM=1.33\cdot10^{20}\ \mathrm{m^3/s^2}$) пролетает тело со скоростью на бесконечности $100\ \mathrm{km/s}$ и прицельным расстоянием $1.33\cdot10^{12}\ \mathrm{m}$. Каков примерно угол отклонения в радианах?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: D. GM/(sv²) = 0.01 kichik; θ ≈ 2GM/(sv²) = 0.02 rad.
Asos: og'ish burchagi.
source: original (B2-L08, sochilish)

question_en: A satellite on a circular orbit of radius $r$ has period $T_1$. It transfers to a circular orbit of radius $4r$ along a Hohmann ellipse. How many $T_1$ does the transfer take?
question_uz: Radiusi $r$ aylana orbitadagi yo'ldosh davri $T_1$. U radiusi $4r$ aylana orbitaga Hohmann ellipsi bo'ylab o'tadi. O'tish vaqti $T_1$ ning necha qismiga teng?
question_ru: Период спутника на круговой орбите радиусом $r$ равен $T_1$. Он переходит на круговую орбиту радиусом $4r$ по гомановскому эллипсу. Скольким $T_1$ равно время перехода?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: E. a = 2.5r; o'tish — ellips davrining yarmi: ½·2.5·√2.5 ≈ 1.98 T₁.
Asos: Hohmann o'tishi.

en: Transfer ellipse $a=\frac{r+4r}{2}=2.5r$; the time is half a period: $$t=\frac{1}{2}\cdot2.5^{3/2}T_1\approx1.98T_1$$

source: original (B2-L08, Hohmann o'tishi)
